category_title: Low socially competent children who engage in disruptive alternative activities when bored
scenario_title: Independent assignment with boredom and peer distraction
minimal_context: The student is working on an independent assignment at their desk while the teacher is talking to another student.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please go ahead and start working on your independent assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves his eyes to his paper and leans on his hands, expressing boredom. He wipes the paper and plays with a pen, then glances at the teacher.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to focus on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at his peer's paper, gets up, walks towards the teacher, but turns around and goes back to his desk. He yawns, expressing boredom.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to finish the task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins to play with a pen and a rubber. Looks at Pekka, leans towards him and whispers) Pekka …Pekka …Pekka. (Waits for a response, then says) Pekka …look. (He looks at his own rubber and continues rolling it with his pen.)

context.social_setting: Teacher is talking to another student

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When temporarily losing focus on the task and experiencing boredom
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Yawns, expressing boredom, and begins to play with a pen and a rubber. Looks at Pekka, leans towards him and whispers, 'Pekka …Pekka …Pekka' and waits for his response. Says, 'Pekka …look'. Rolls rubber with his pen.

behavior_patterns.condition: When struggling to stay on task and looking for external cues or help
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Moves his eyes to his paper and leans on his hands. Wipes the paper and plays with a pen. Glances at the teacher. Gets up, walks towards the teacher but turns around and goes back to his desk.
